reviews.review_title: Nice game, but needs an update
reviews.review_description: Not the best out there, but yeah, it's one of the good games. It just needs an update now some more depth in the gameplay would really help. Though I won't complain since it's still in early access hope you guys bring some cool stuff in the next update!

developer_response.body: Thanks so much for the honest feedback and for playing during early access! We're actively working on adding more depth to the gameplay and rolling out updates regularly. Your review helps us prioritize what to focus on next, stay tuned for upcoming updates, and feel free to reach out if you have specific features or content you'd like to see added!
